summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of its own ordinary shares for cancellation as part of a buy-back announced 5 August 2026. On 27 August 2026, HSBC repurchased 3,000,000 shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of £15.0911 and 342,400 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$161.7793, for a total consideration of approximately US$478.1 million since commencement. All repurchases are market transactions under relevant regulations, shares cancelled, no treasury shares held. Watch continuity of the buy-back program and share count reduction.
